admission.justification: Only the combination of hold-time reset indexing, startup adoption of aged waits, bounded deadline-driven delivery, and documented D987 bounds guarantees post-reset clearance across restarts and backlogs.

guarantee: Provider-limited held messages with a known reset timestamp survive queue expiry and dashboard restarts through a generation-fenced durable reset index, are enrolled at startup without overwriting live schedules, and wake through an independent 16-worker scheduler aligned with the documented D987 delivery ceiling.
title: Provider-limited held-message reset delivery
